title: Siman 228
section: His Journey and Residence in Uman

segments.he: שֶׁעָסַק בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ. שֶׁצִּיֵּר בְּדַעְתּוֹ שֶׁאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה
segments.en: (44.) He once said: "Have they not broken us like a broken vessel! — Did I not think that you would all be tzaddikim? Great tzaddikim with such intellect — such intellect as has not existed in many generations — and now they have broken us like a broken vessel."
